Printing workflow

Artwork and paper construction are approved together.

We review print coverage, colors, artwork repeat, paper surface and intended food use before sampling. “Printing first. Silicone coating after.” applies only to selected approved printed parchment constructions where that sequence is part of the agreed specification; it is not a blanket claim for every product.

Artwork & color review

Confirm files, print colors, repeat, coverage and the reference sample before production.

Material & treatment review

Match paper, coating or treatment to the required release, grease, temperature and food-contact conditions.

Pack presentation

Plan bulk, foodservice, retail or private-label packs with labels, counts and export cartons.

Five-stage OEM process

A clear path from requirement to repeat order.

01

Requirement confirmation

Share the food application, size, material performance, quantity, destination market, artwork and pack requirements.

02

Sample development

Confirm construction, artwork, color, dimensions and pack presentation through an agreed sample route.

03

Approved production

Manufacture against the approved material, artwork, sample and packing instruction.

04

Quality inspection

Review relevant material, dimensions, appearance, print, pack count and shipment preparation checkpoints.

05

Global delivery

Coordinate export cartons, shipping marks, documents and the agreed delivery plan.

Project brief

The more specific the brief, the more useful the first sample.

  • Product type, size or reference sample
  • Food application and use conditions
  • Artwork, print colors and packaging format
  • Estimated quantity and destination market
  • Required documents and target timing
